title: El mercado y el Estado
goal: Read how 1990s reforms flipped the state's role from planner and owner (under ISI) to a market-driven model with lower tariffs, independent central banks, and active courting of foreign investment.

items: Describe the state's role under the ISI model.
Explain what neoliberal reforms proposed instead.
Explain why many countries granted central banks more independence.
Describe the shift in attitude toward foreign investment.
Use frente a to contrast two models or positions.
